name: Tolibut
summary: Analogue of GABA and the 4-methyl analogue of phenibut. The drug is reported to have similar effects to phenibut and GABA, the drug acts on GABA(B).

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Tolibut has been described as possessing analgesic, tranquilizing, and neuroprotective properties.

uses.text: It is not fully clear as to whether the drug was ever approved or used medically in Russia.
